name: expanded_v5_shared_three_seeds
selection: Best epoch by validation Macro-F1 within each run; family by mean validation Macro-F1 over ALL seeds. Representative deployment seed fixed at 42 before training. No selection by test or hand-picked examples.
test_status: Provisional development labels; documents from earlier development pools may be reassigned. This is not a fresh independent final benchmark.
purpose: Compare six classifier families on exactly the same frozen text-only inputs after source expansion and author/work/template grouping.
limitations: Source/category and assistant-screened labels have not been independently adjudicated by human experts.
Publisher and length distributions still correlate with style; removing URLs does not remove this confounding.
Known author and work IDs are grouped; unknown authors and unidentified aliases remain a limitation.
Collected business templates are training-only. Reserved AYU forms are excluded from this dataset.
This changes data composition, excerpt policy, group allocation and hardware/precision relative to v4. A difference from v4 is not a controlled causal estimate of data cleaning.
GPU mixed-precision results can differ from CPU results despite the same seed. Timing is not directly comparable across hardware.
